timecodedFindings.observation: Stable admitted wardrobe pixels: one adult, front-facing Heroine in the yellow-plaid E04 look; separately hung navy corporate before-state; distinct E01 pink/tulle, E02 periwinkle/plaid with boots, and E03 pink-cardigan/black-skirt looks. No identity, clothing, background, or palette regression; no flash, brown overlay, generic stage, door wipe, or five-state morph.
The single directional wipe is clean and keeps all wardrobe pixels stable. Its magenta face, teal edge/splice, display weight, and hierarchy remain coherent without clipping or a full-screen flash.
At full size, NOW ENTERING is the smaller lead-in and SUNNYVAiLE is the dominant line. The i after V is visibly lower case with a separate dot; the predecessor's all-caps I defect is resolved.
The full lockup, including the dotted lower-case i, stays readable and unclipped immediately before the 08:20 assembly out.
The retained one-second handle is visually safe: title and admitted wardrobe remain stable and no white tail or endpoint discontinuity appears.

unproven: Authoring-method provenance is not established by a visual review; maker assertions were not used as quality authority.

learningDisposition.resolvedLearning: A brand spelling that depends on lower-case characters must remain visibly distinguishable in the selected display type, not merely be correct in an editor field.
